cards.name: Blaze End Dragon
cards.effect:
3 FIRE Wyrm monsters
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can activate this effect; for the rest of this turn, destroy all other monsters whose ATK is different from its original ATK. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can pay any number of LP in multiples of 100; this card's ATK becomes equal to the amount paid, also you can make all other monsters currently on the field lose ATK/DEF equal to this card's current ATK.
